messages:
maria: Hey team — quick ping for reviews on PR #2417 (quant-routing + kv_cache TTL tweak). Changes: default kv_cache_ttl 30s -> 90s for long-seq traces, and a routing cost threshold so requests with slack in latency are sent to cheaper quant variants. Need approvals for a Dedicated rollout and a short canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2417 :eyes:
tj: can you paste the perf numbers and which models + dataset you ran? also any stability concerns?
maria: sure — quick run summary:
- model: llama-13b (auto-quant flow)
- workload: 10k traces, seq_len ~512 distribution
- baseline p50=85ms, p99=210ms
- patch p50=92ms (+8ms), p99=220ms (+10ms)
- cost per token: -11% (better batching + routing to 4-bit variant)
config used:
```yaml
kv_cache_ttl: 90
routing_threshold: 0.25  # fraction of slack to prefer cheap route
```
quality: ran eval harness (prompt-set A, safety/neg tests) — no actionable regressions, metric noise only. added smoke regression tests.
sanjay: thanks — any regression tests around kv cache eviction behavior? curious about memory pressure in heavy KV reuse workloads.
maria: added unit test for eviction logic and a perf smoke that simulates KV churn; memory didn't spike in our env but worth monitoring in Dedicated. also added feature flag `enable_cost_routing` so we can toggle per-customer.
leo: would you consider splitting TTL change vs routing into separate PRs? hard to review both together.
maria: thought about it — they interact in the cost model, so bundling reduces flip-flop risk. but if reviewers prefer, I can split.
tj: actionable ask: add a short note in the PR about interaction with prefix caching and the batcher (how ttl increase affects prefix cache hit rate). also mark the Dedicated rollout as guarded behind the feature flag.
maria: done — updated PR description and added `enable_cost_routing` guard; also documented expected p50 delta in PR comment.
ci-bot: Unit tests ✅, Perf smoke ✅ — all checks passed. (build 7842)
tj: +1 assuming canary. The +8ms p50 is acceptable for 11% cost savings but let's run a 24h canary at 5% then 25% if stable. Need dashboard for latency/throughput/cost.
sanjay: +1 for the 24h canary and want alert if p99 increases >12% or cost delta < -6%.
leo: I can own the canary rollout and dashboard. I’ll schedule tomorrow 08:00 PST for 5% canary and send the grafana link. Approved pending canary results. :thumbsup:
maria: awesome — scheduling now. will post dashboard and final signoff once canary completes. thanks y'all! :rocket:
leo: quick note — keep an eye on Dedicated customers with small batch sizes; routing might not help there. I'll add a temporary policy to exclude low-throughput pools during canary.
maria: noted, thanks. merging blocked until canary completes. will update thread with results.
leo: sounds good. :eyes:
